title: Cu/Cu2O/NH2-MIL-88B (Fe) heterojunction as the photocatalyst to remove hexavalent chromium heavy metal ions in water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2462-2469
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08143A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chunhua Xu
Cu/Cu2O/NH2-MIL-88B (Fe) heterojunction material under the condition of pH = 2, ethanol as a sacrificial agent, dark adsorption for 60 min, photocatalytic reduction for 150 min, the photocatalytic adsorption reduction rate of Cr(VI) was 96.3%.
